scripts.build:web-component: npm run build --workspace=packages/lib && npm run build --workspace=packages/web-component
scripts.build:playground-lib: npm run build:lib && npm run build:lib --workspace=packages/playground
scripts.demo:wc: npm run build --workspace=packages/lib && npm run demo --workspace=packages/web-component
scripts.playground: npm run build --workspace=packages/lib && concurrently "npm run watch --workspace=packages/lib" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/playground"
scripts.release: npm run build --workspace=packages/lib && npm run build --workspace=packages/web-component && changeset publish
